title: Tunisian Roasted Tofu
description: A flavorful and healthy Tunisian-inspired dish featuring roasted tofu, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: or make your own with cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with Tunisian spice blend. Toss to coat.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the tofu is roasting, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chopped red onion and bell pepper, and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Once the tofu is done roasting, add it to the skillet and toss with the vegetables.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
